about: Alert rules on CHANGES (a static condition such as 'score under 20' is already the dashboard sorted by at-risk; these fire when something moves), evaluated by scripts/evaluate_rules.py at every watch run. Fork this file: each rule is a name, a plain condition over the fields below, and a severity. Fields: score (0-100), delta (change since the previous run, null if none), stale (true/false), tvl_usd (DefiLlama, null if not matched), at_risk_usd (tvl × (100 - score) / 100), admin, multisig, timelock, price_feed, shared (the five sub-scores), chain, title. From the timelock queue: queued_ops (operations queued against this contract), ready_in_hours (until the earliest executes; negative = ready now), executed_14d (operations queued in the last 14 days that have left the queue: run or cancelled; one still waiting is in queued_ops). Per-axis change since the previous run: admin_delta, multisig_delta, timelock_delta (null on the first run). From the independent reader (scripts/second_opinion.py): second_opinion ('agree', 'disagree', 'reviewed', 'unreadable', 'native', null when not read) admin_changed (true when the live admin read moved since the previous run) shared_admin (how many other tracked contracts the same holder governs, null when not read) and age_days (days since the score was last pushed on-chain; the oracles mark it stale at 9). Operators: <, <=, >, >=, ==, !=, + and -, and/or/not, parentheses. The dashboard evaluates the same syntax in the browser with two extra fields (held, starred) and without not; a null compares false here.

rules.name: score dropped by 10 or more
score fell under 40
rules.when: delta != null and score < 40 and score - delta >= 40

rules.name: score improved by 10 or more
delay removed: timelock score fell to 0
rules.when: timelock_delta != null and timelock_delta < 0 and timelock == 0

rules.name: a queued change against this contract executes within 48 h
rules.when: queued_ops > 0 and ready_in_hours != null and ready_in_hours <= 48 and ready_in_hours > 0

rules.name: a queued change against this contract is ready to execute now
rules.when: queued_ops > 0 and ready_in_hours != null and ready_in_hours <= 0

rules.name: the live admin of this contract changed since the previous run (independent read)
the independent reader disagrees with the admin-key score, with money behind it
rules.when: second_opinion == 'disagree' and tvl_usd != null and tvl_usd >= 10000000

rules.name: score pushed more than 7 days ago (the oracle marks it stale at 9)
rules.when: age_days != null and age_days >= 7 and not stale

rules.name: the score is under public dispute (data/disputes.json), review pending
an upgrade was executed: the implementation behind this contract changed since the previous run
an admin transfer is in flight: a new owner or admin is designated and has not accepted yet (pendingOwner / pendingAdmin)
the contract's own balance fell by 30% to 70% since the previous run (totalAssets(), token units, $1M or more gone)
rules.when: held_drop_pct != null and held_drop_pct >= 30 and held_drop_pct < 70 and held_drop_usd != null and held_drop_usd >= 1000000

rules.name: the contract's own balance fell by 70% or more since the previous run (totalAssets(), token units, $1M or more gone)
rules.when: held_drop_pct != null and held_drop_pct >= 70 and held_drop_usd != null and held_drop_usd >= 1000000

rules.name: the contract reported its own balance (totalAssets()) in a previous run and no longer does
the contract has been paused since the previous run (paused() or isPaused() now true)
the contract is no longer paused (paused() or isPaused() now false)
a secondary role of the contract (curator, guardian, pauser) changed hands, was set or was cleared, or a change of guardian or of delay is announced
the contract's own delay is announced to get shorter (pendingTimelock() lower than timelock()): less time to react to the owner
the Safe that governs this contract, observed idle for 14 days or more, executed a transaction (nonce moved), with money behind it
rules.when: safe_woke and tvl_usd != null and tvl_usd >= 10000000
